google-hotels.description: Google Hotels + Vacation Rentals search with 7-provider OTA price comparison (Booking.com, Expedia, Vrbo, Hotels.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Tripadvisor), 3-month daily price calendar, rate parity, and party-size filters. Pinned to v0.1.1 for reproducible installs. Pay-per-use via Apify.

filesystem.description: Read and write itinerary files, saved hotel searches, and booking confirmations.

fetch.description: Fetch destination articles, visa requirements, airline pages, and travel advisories.

memory.description: Track traveler preferences, past bookings, loyalty programs, and watched destinations across sessions.
